files.description: OpenAPI 3.0.1 specification serving as the b(10) EHI export data dictionary. Defines 35 schemas with 279 fields documenting the proprietary JSON export format for patient data. This is the primary artifact — it describes the complete structure of RevolutionEHR's EHI export.
Full HTML of the certification disclosures page containing the b(10) export description text, FHIR API links, certification details, and Real World Testing plan/results links.
Full-page screenshot of the certification disclosures page captured via browser, showing the complete page layout including the b(10) export documentation section.
Bun TypeScript script that parses openapiServices.json and extracts structured schema information into queryable JSON, including field definitions, types, relationships, and coverage accounting.
Enriched extraction of all 35 schemas with 279 fields, inter-schema relationships, cross-references, type information, required flags, and descriptions. Queryable JSON for downstream analysis.
Parse statistics: total schemas discovered (35), total schemas parsed (35), zero parse failures, total fields extracted (279), and root Patient schema field listing.
Enrichment documentation with run commands, input boundary, output files, and known parsing limitations.
